Upon examining the code snippet for `get_target_path`, we find that it relies on `target.project_id` to format the target path, which is not provided in the test case. Therefore, the error occurs due to the absence of this attribute in the test-provided `BigQueryTarget` object.

```

To resolve the issue, you should update the `BigQueryTarget` initialization method to accept an optional `project_id` parameter with a default value. This way, when no `project_id` is provided in the test case, it will not raise an `AttributeError`.
